skill_name: Discuss the enforcement of a "cell phone safe-zone" policy in the workplace
workflow: Creating a "cell phone safe-zone" policy in the workplace is an important step towards maintaining a professional workplace environment. This policy would clearly delineate a specific area where cell phone use is not allowed, and this should be clearly communicated to all employees. Employers should also provide a system for employees to report any violations of the policy as well as a punishment system for those who are found in violation.
